title.narrative: Operation of the Emergency Center for Combating Epidemic Diseases in Hajjah Governorate 6

description.narrative: Saving lives, preserving their continuity, limiting the spread of diseases and epidemics, and providing emergency health services to combat epidemics and enhance them in some liberated districts in Hajjah Governorate.

Saving lives, preserving their continuity, limiting the spread of diseases and epidemics, and providing emergency health services to combat epidemics and enhance them in some liberated districts in Hajjah Governorate.

The emergency center is fully prepared for rapid diagnosis and provision of emergency health services to combat epidemics for (81,512) beneficiaries, (95%) of the beneficiaries have received their needs of therapeutic and diagnostic medicines, provision of therapeutic, preventive and diagnostic services, provision of treatment and isolation services for cases infected with epidemics and field surveys to investigate epidemics and their causes and health education to prevent them through lectures and workshops on health practices and prevention of diseases and epidemics, with the provision of brochures and educational panels, distribution of mosquito nets and implementation of fogging campaigns, preservation of the environment and prevention of the spread of epidemics by burning waste in the incinerator designated for that.
